content:
mira: T-minus 45 for the EU launch window. Quick sweep: canary deployed? DB migration flag? feature flags ready? whoever's oncall please confirm.

alex: Canary is live on eu-canary-03, traffic at 2%. CPU and p50/p95 look healthy. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary deployment complete. service=api, sha=8f3a1d pinned for 30m. Monitoring checks: OK. (automated)

josh: Rollback playbook is up-to-date in Confluence. Added a short `rollback --to <sha>` snippet. Oncall: @samir are you watching?

samir: Oncall here, standing by. I have emergency unpin perms and can promote fallback model. DB migration flag `migrate_users_v3` is OFF.

lia: Release notes uploaded: https://confluence.redwood/relnotes/1.42. Highlighting embedding param changes and cost note. Docs PR merged.

ops: Heads up — background job batch-size default changed. Could cause mem spikes under heavy backfill. We've bumped autoscale threshold to 85% just in case.

alex: Can we run a quick smoke against the embeddings pipeline? I'm seeing a small tail on long prompts in staging.

mira: Alex please run it now and paste results. If tail > 500ms we hold the ramp.

alex: Smoke run results: 100 queries, p95=120ms, p99=540ms, one outlier on an 8k prompt. Logs: https://logs.redwood/trace/abc123

josh: p99 540ms > 500ms threshold. Recommend holding canary at 1% until we confirm mitigation. Who can reduce canary traffic?

deploy-bot: Canary traffic update requested by @josh. Adjusting: eu-canary-03 -> 1% (was 2%). Change recorded.

mira: Good catch. Holding at 1% for next 20m. We'll run another regression and smoke run. If stable, proceed with 25% increments.

samir: Oncall ack. I'll watch error budget and be ready to cut to fallback model `model-v2-small` if errors exceed 0.5%.

lia: Added rollback blurb to release notes and runbook with exact unpin steps and contact points.

mira: Final check — everyone OK with proceeding under a 1% hold and manual ramp? please reply with :thumbsup: to proceed.

alex: :thumbsup:

josh: :thumbsup:

samir: :thumbsup:

lia: :thumbsup:

mira: Locking this thread. I'll post final go/no-go in ~15m after the next smoke run.
